assessment.nobel_worthiness: Recollision gives an intelligible physical mechanism for strong-field electron motion, while its quantum description makes emission and atomic dynamics quantitative. This is fundamental explanatory physics.

assessment.maturity: The mechanism and framework have been tested through decades of strong-field experiments.
uncertainties: Clarify the boundary with prior recognition of attosecond methods and review omitted theoretical contributions.
My field proximity warrants independent scrutiny of attribution.
